name: Per-Application Volume Control
author: JoaoDEVWHADS
description: Control the volume of individual applications using keyboard shortcuts. Press Ctrl+NVDA+Y to open the volume control dialog and adjust volume per application. Supports precise volume control with multiple increment levels and real-time announcements. Tested on NVDA 2025.3.2. Users may modify manifest.ini for other versions. Contact: https://t.me/tierryt2021
